li.label: a sleeping draught
li.description: Somebody mixed me a draught to help me sleep. It tasted awful, and I slept until noon.

li.label: taught hungry neighbors to farm
li.description: I showed some hungry neighbors how to get more out of their fields and sent them home with seed. I hope it takes.

li.label: talked them round
li.description: I sat down with our guests when it could have gone badly, and talked until it didn't. It took all afternoon.

li.label: couldn't talk them round
li.description: The council sent me to settle things with our guests. I said the wrong thing early and never got it back.

li.label: treated by one of our own
li.description: Our own doctor took a proper look at my old injury, instead of some stranger. It aches less already.

li.label: treated a patient well
li.description: They trusted me with a patient instead of paying a stranger. I didn't let them down.

li.label: an evening at the play
li.description: The traveling player did every part in the show after supper. I'm still humming the song from the end.

li.label: a child named after me
li.description: A baby out there carries my name now. I keep wondering what they'll be like.

li.label: a wedding back home
li.description: Someone from my old life got married, and they thought of me. I'd have liked to dance at that wedding.

li.label: they still talk about my work
li.description: Far from here, people still talk about my work from years back. I thought all that was long forgotten.
